info.name: M39.3 — Public Booking + Public Commerce (MoMo Pending) + Nimbus Ops Portal
info.description:
# M39.3 — Public Booking Website + Public Commerce Payment Skeleton + Nimbus Ops Portal

**Purpose**

Third repo-local split milestone after M39.1 (commercial foundation) and M39.2 (onboarding + merchant public setup). M39.3 fully owns:

- **Public diner browse flows** — restaurants, restaurant detail + availability, restaurant events, public events list/detail. **No auth required.**
- **Reservation hold + confirm** — 15-minute hold expiry, audited.
- **Event-booking hold + confirm** — capacity enforcement, audited. Free events confirm cleanly; paid events return a clear refusal until M39.x mobile-money execution lands.
- **Public commerce payment skeleton** — `/public/payments/*` routes that always return `{ status: "PENDING_INTEGRATION", provider: "MOBILE_MONEY", message: "..." }`. **NOT LIVE. NOT PesaPal.**
- **Nimbus Ops Portal** — internal-only `/ops/*` views over customers, subscriptions due / grace period, onboarding pipeline, merchant payment readiness, and ops support sessions.

## Locked rules
1. **No auth on `/public/*` browse + holds + confirms.**
2. **Public payments are NOT live.** Every `/public/payments/*` request must return `PENDING_INTEGRATION` / `MOBILE_MONEY`. Do not describe them as PesaPal — PesaPal is reserved for owner SaaS subscription billing only (see M39.1).
3. **Callback / IPN routes are reserved future contracts only.** They acknowledge inbound calls but do not execute any provider flow.
4. **Ops support sessions** here are explicitly the internal Nimbus-staff view and are separate from the owner-facing `/support/sessions` foundation introduced in M39.1.
5. Only **published** restaurants and events appear on public endpoints.

## Continuity from M39.1 + M39.2
- Reuses `PublicProfile`, `PublicEvent`, `ReservationHold`, `EventBookingHold`, `PendingPaymentIntent`, `MerchantPaymentConfig`, `SupportSession`, `Subscription`, `OnboardingProgress` schemas — **no migration in M39.3**.
- Reuses M39.1 SaaS PesaPal billing, Developer Portal, plan catalog policies untouched.
- Reuses M39.2 onboarding + booking-settings persistence + event capacity / pricing rules untouched.

## Run order
00 → A → B → C → D → E → F

request.description:
**Audience:** anyone running this M39.3 collection.

**Story:**
1. **A. Public Restaurant Browse** — anonymous diner lists published restaurants, opens one by slug, checks availability.
2. **B. Public Event Browse** — anonymous diner browses upcoming public events.
3. **C. Reservation Holds + Confirm** — anonymous diner places a 15-minute reservation hold, then confirms (free / no-payment path).
4. **D. Event Booking Holds + Confirm** — anonymous diner holds tickets for a free event, then confirms. Capacity is enforced.
5. **E. Public Commerce Payments — Pending Mobile Money Integration** — every request returns `PENDING_INTEGRATION` / `MOBILE_MONEY`. **DO NOT describe as PesaPal.** Callback / IPN routes are reserved-future-contract scaffolds.
6. **F. Nimbus Ops Portal** — internal Nimbus staff view: customers, subscriptions due / grace, onboarding pipeline, merchant payment readiness, support sessions open / list / close.

**Reminder:**
- A–E are public/no-auth except the payment scaffold which still accepts the request (no auth, no execution).
- F requires a Nimbus internal staff bearer with `ops:*` permissions.

This `GET /health` request is just a green-check that the API is reachable.

item.name: B.1 — List upcoming public events (no auth)

request.description:

**Purpose:** lists all `PUBLISHED` events with `startsAt` in the future.

**Real-world example:** the 'Upcoming Events' page of the public site.

item.name: B.2 — Get event by slug (no auth)

request.description:
**Audience:** anonymous public diner.

**Purpose:** returns the public detail of a single event. 404 if unknown or unpublished.

**Real-world example:** opening the event detail page from a discovery list.

item.name: C.1 — Hold a reservation (no auth, 15-min expiry)

request.description:
**Audience:** anonymous public diner.

**Purpose:** creates a `ReservationHold` with status `HELD` and a 15-minute `expiresAt`. Audited as `PUBLIC_RESERVATION_HOLD_CREATED`.

**Real-world example:** diner clicks 'Hold this slot' before entering payment / confirmation details. No deposit is required at this step.

item.name: C.2 — Confirm the held reservation (no auth, free path)

request.description:
**Audience:** anonymous public diner.

**Purpose:** flips the hold to `CONFIRMED` (free / no-payment path). Audited as `PUBLIC_RESERVATION_CONFIRMED`.

**Errors:**
- 409 if the hold is not `HELD` or has expired (in which case the hold flips to `EXPIRED` and `PUBLIC_RESERVATION_HOLD_EXPIRED` is audited).

**Future-compat:** when deposits are introduced, this endpoint will require a successful `intentId` from `/public/payments/reservations/checkout-session` first.

item.name: D.1 — Hold event tickets (no auth, capacity enforced)

request.description:
**Audience:** anonymous public diner.

**Purpose:** holds N tickets for an event. Refuses with 409 if `bookedCount + ticketCount > capacity` (when capacity > 0). 15-min `expiresAt`. Audited as `PUBLIC_EVENT_BOOKING_HOLD_CREATED`.

**Real-world example:** diner reserves 2 tickets for a Friday wine night before paying.

item.name: D.2 — Confirm event booking (no auth, free event path)

request.description:
**Audience:** anonymous public diner.

**Purpose:** confirms a free event booking — increments `PublicEvent.bookedCount` and flips the hold to `CONFIRMED`. Audited as `PUBLIC_EVENT_BOOKING_CONFIRMED`.

**Errors:**
- 409 if the hold has expired (audited as `PUBLIC_EVENT_BOOKING_HOLD_EXPIRED`).
- 409 with message `Public commerce payments are pending implementation.` if the underlying event is paid (`isFree=false`). Use folder E to obtain a `PENDING_INTEGRATION` intent until MTN/Airtel ships.

item.name: E. Public Commerce Payments — Pending Mobile Money Integration
E.0 — READ FIRST: this folder is NOT LIVE

request.description:
**Audience:** anyone testing E.

**Purpose:** banner. Every request in folder E will return:

```json
{
  "status": "PENDING_INTEGRATION",
  "provider": "MOBILE_MONEY",
  "message": "Public commerce payment execution is not yet enabled pending MTN/Airtel integration confirmation."
}
```

**Rules:**
- These endpoints are NOT PesaPal. PesaPal is reserved exclusively for owner SaaS subscription billing — see M39.1.
- Callback / IPN are **reserved future contracts**. They acknowledge inbound calls but do not execute any provider flow.
- `reconcile-status` echoes the `orderTrackingId` for traceability and returns the same pending response.
- Every `checkout-session` call still creates a `PendingPaymentIntent` row and emits `PUBLIC_PAYMENT_CHECKOUT_ATTEMPTED` in the audit log.

// (the C.1/C.2 hold has been CONFIRMED by this point and is no longer eligible).
if (!slug) { console.log('No restaurantSlug — skipping E.1'); return; }
if (err) { console.log('hold sendRequest error', err); return; }
try { const j = res.json(); if (j.holdId) pm.collectionVariables.set('reservationHoldId', j.holdId); } catch (e) {}

request.description:
**Audience:** anonymous public diner (future flow).

**Purpose:** **scaffold only.** Validates the hold exists and is `HELD`, persists a `PendingPaymentIntent` for traceability, and returns the uniform `PENDING_INTEGRATION` / `MOBILE_MONEY` response. **No PesaPal. No execution.**

**Real-world example (future):** when deposits are required, the diner will hit this endpoint right after `C.1` to obtain an MTN/Airtel STK push reference. Today, it just returns the pending banner.

if (err) { console.log('hold sendRequest error', err); return; }
try { const j = res.json(); if (j.holdId) pm.collectionVariables.set('eventBookingHoldId', j.holdId); } catch (e) {}

item.name: F.3 — Subscriptions due in next 7 days

request.description:
**Audience:** Nimbus internal staff (`ops:subscriptions:read`).

**Purpose:** lists ACTIVE subscriptions whose `currentPeriodEnd` is within 7 days — the renewal pipeline.

**Real-world example:** the 'Renewals this week' widget on the ops dashboard.

**Audience:** Nimbus internal staff (`ops:subscriptions:read`).

**Purpose:** lists `GRACE_PERIOD` subscriptions — owners who have failed billing and are within their grace window.

**Real-world example:** customer-success follow-up queue.

**Audience:** Nimbus internal staff (`ops:onboarding:read`).

**Purpose:** lists every org whose `OnboardingProgress.completedAt` is null — i.e. customers still mid-wizard.

**Real-world example:** spotting orgs stuck on a step (e.g. invitations not sent) so a CSM can reach out.

**Audience:** Nimbus internal staff (`ops:merchant-payments:read`).

**Purpose:** lists every `MerchantPaymentConfig` row — `NOT_CONFIGURED | PENDING_MTN | PENDING_AIRTEL | READY_FOR_INTEGRATION | LIVE | DISABLED` (`provider = 'MOBILE_MONEY'`).

**Real-world example:** ops queue of merchants waiting for MTN/Airtel onboarding to complete before public diner payments go live.

**Audience:** Nimbus internal staff (`ops:support:read`).

**Purpose:** lists the most recent 50 ops support sessions, with the customer org and the staff who opened/closed them.

**Note:** this is the **internal Nimbus-staff** support view. It is intentionally separate from the **owner-facing** `/support/sessions` foundation introduced in M39.1.

**Audience:** Nimbus internal staff (`ops:support:write`).

**Purpose:** opens a new support session against a customer org. Audited as `SUPPORT_SESSION_OPENED`. Auto-expires in 4 hours.

**Real-world example:** an ops engineer starts a session before reaching into a customer's data to debug.

**Audience:** Nimbus internal staff (`ops:support:write`).

**Purpose:** closes the session, recording who closed it and why. Audited as `SUPPORT_SESSION_CLOSED`. Refuses with 409 if the session is not OPEN.
